metadata.title: RECHERCHES DE CHIMIE MÉDICALE SUR L'HÉMATINE

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and thin, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Didot or Bodoni), which was prevalent in French academic and medical publishing during the late 19th century.
